pairs.name: crosshatch
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with Crosshatch right: the dark stage becomes a dense net of crossing ink lines, her arms and dress stay pale paper with a few diagonal strokes, and the folds of the dress are drawn with more line directions where they are darker
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Crosshatch at its default settings.

pairs.name: vector-tiling
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with Vector Engraving right: the dark stage becomes rows of heavy, wavy ink lines with thin pale gaps, while her arms and dress turn into pale paper crossed by fine straight hairlines that follow the folds
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Vector Engraving at its default settings.
